new_skill_modules.name: change-control
new_skill_modules.description: Gate deployment change control — ensures log-before-enforce, monitors readiness

new_skill_modules.name: conflict-resolution
new_skill_modules.description: Detect and resolve conflicts between lessons, specs, and hooks

new_skill_modules.name: decision-check
new_skill_modules.description: Check DECISIONS.md for contradictions or stale decisions

new_skill_modules.name: lesson-review
new_skill_modules.description: Review lessons board, check for new lessons, apply resolved ones

new_skill_modules.name: pattern-detector
new_skill_modules.description: Detect circular rebuilds, repeated failures, token hemorrhage

new_skill_modules.name: session-analyzer
new_skill_modules.description: Quantitative session analysis — tool counts, command frequency, anti-patterns

benefits: Modular enable/disable per metacognition task (no monolithic cron prompts)
Two-tier model: quick (15m) for cheap checks, deep (1h) for expensive analysis
Structured output to daily logs instead of ad-hoc appending
Conflict resolution: automated detection of lesson/spec contradictions
Pattern detection: catches circular rebuilds and token waste automatically
Lesson review: structural integrity checks on lesson files
Dry-run mode for previewing what each cycle would do
Shareable as an OpenClaw skill (.skill package)
